title: Lukewarm customer experience
body:
I applied for Wio Personal over a month ago and since then, my application has been stuck in a sort of limbo, listed as "Under Review" with no further updates or feedback from the team. This has been particularly frustrating for me, as I have been a loyal user of Wio Business for my company for over six months.

I had higher expectations for Wio, given my previous experience with their business service. However, the lack of communication and the seemingly endless wait for application approval have made this an incredibly disappointing experience. It's disheartening to see that Wio Personal doesn't seem to maintain the same standard of customer service and efficiency that I have come to expect from their business offering.

Would I recommend Wio Personal based on this experience? Unfortunately, no. I hope the team takes note and works on improving their application and review process for future customers.
author: Kunstlerischerleiter

reply.body:
We would like to begin by expressing our sincere apologies for the disappointing experience you've encountered during your application process for Wio Personal. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we genuinely appreciate you taking the time to share your concerns. We appreciate your loyalty to Wio Business and understand the expectation of a similar level of service with Wio Personal. Rest assured, we are committed to ensuring that all our customers, regardless of the service they use, receive the same high standard of customer service and efficiency. 
 If you would like to discuss your application or have any further questions or comments, please don't hesitate to reach out through our social media channels, or reach out to our Wio care team at 600 500 946 or via E-mail at care@wio.io.

reply.body:
Hello there! Our intention is to provide a range of options to cater to different customer needs; hence, we've got two price plans: standard and plus. The standard plan will be free of charge if you maintain a monthly average balance of AED 3,000 only. With the Plus plan, it will be free of charge if you maintain a monthly average balance of AED 35,000.
Here’s a sneak peak of the benefits that come with the Wio personal account:
1) 6% p.a. interest on savings.
2) Commission-free trading: start with just US$1.
3) 1% cashback on AED card spends
4) Send money globally to over 100 countries—best rates, no hidden fees
5) Transparent and straightforward fees.
